My work focuses on efficient and trustworthy generative modelling for medical imaging.

## Efficient 3D and 4D generation

Designing models that can synthesise high-resolution volumetric and temporal data under realistic memory and compute constraints.

## Medical generation evaluation

Evaluating synthetic data beyond a single realism score, including diversity, memorisation, privacy, anatomical validity, and downstream utility.

## Scientific infrastructure

Building reproducible links between literature, code, experiments, evaluation, and communication.

Project pages and verified public resources will be added as they are ready for release.
